headline: Dhaka University suspends four professors over July Uprising roles
summary: The university syndicate took action against teachers for controversial activities and threats to students during the protests.
details: The Dhaka University syndicate has suspended three professors and barred another from academic activities due to their roles and "controversial activities" during the July Uprising.
Professors Nazmul Ahsan Kalimullah, Abul Kashem Mohammad Jamal Uddin, and Shibli Rubayat Ul Islam have been temporarily suspended.
Prof Mohammad Azmal Hossain Bhuiyan of the Botany Department was barred from academic activities for allegedly threatening students and insulting female students over their clothing.
Additionally, teacher Chowdhury Md Tashrik-e-Habib was barred from academic activities following complaints from students and teachers after he went viral for singing a song on social media.
University official Lavlu Molla Shishir was also suspended on similar charges related to the uprising.
The syndicate has also proposed to cancel the DUCSU general secretary post of Golam Rabbani, citing procedural irregularities in his MPhil admission.
caption:
Four Dhaka University professors face suspension and academic bans for their actions during the July Uprising.

The Dhaka University syndicate has suspended three professors and barred another from academic activities due to their roles and "controversial activities" during the July Uprising.

Professors Nazmul Ahsan Kalimullah, Abul Kashem Mohammad Jamal Uddin, and Shibli Rubayat Ul Islam have been temporarily suspended.

Prof Mohammad Azmal Hossain Bhuiyan of the Botany Department was barred from academic activities for allegedly threatening students and insulting female students over their clothing.

Additionally, teacher Chowdhury Md Tashrik-e-Habib was barred from academic activities following complaints from students and teachers after he went viral for singing a song on social media.

University official Lavlu Molla Shishir was also suspended on similar charges related to the uprising.

The syndicate has also proposed to cancel the DUCSU general secretary post of Golam Rabbani, citing procedural irregularities in his MPhil admission.

headline_marked: Govt [[forms special task force]] to combat dengue
headline: Govt forms special task force to combat dengue
summary: A dedicated team will focus on prevention and control measures to curb the spread of the virus.
details: The government has decided to form a special task force to prevent and combat the spread of dengue.
The task force will be responsible for coordinating prevention efforts and implementing control measures across the country.
This move comes as part of a broader strategy to reduce the number of dengue cases and protect public health.
caption:
A special task force is being formed to fight dengue.

The government has decided to form a special task force to prevent and combat the spread of dengue.

The task force will be responsible for coordinating prevention efforts and implementing control measures across the country.

This move comes as part of a broader strategy to reduce the number of dengue cases and protect public health.
